items.title: Avia Collaborates with Visa and Global Payments for Direct Player Payouts to Eligible Visa Cards
items.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, November 12, 2026--AviaGames, a leader in casual, skill-based mobile games, is collaborating with Visa, a world leader in digital payments, and Global Payments®, a leading payment technology and software company, to give eligible U.S. players the ability to receive payouts from Avia’s mobile games directly to their eligible Visa cards. The integration is now available for players.
